latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of the LinkedIn automation skill.

- Automate LinkedIn actions via CLI: search people/companies, fetch profiles, send messages and InMails, manage connections, create posts, comment, and react.
- Sales Navigator support included.
- Flexible search and filter options for people, companies, and connections.
- Cloud browser ensures real, non-instant interactions (actions may take 30 seconds to minutes).
- Machine-readable JSON outputs and robust error reporting by exit codes.
- Simple authentication required via Linked API tokens.
